name: Elemental Master
summary: Arcanists with an affinity for elemental forces sometimes focus on one and display its power in everything they do.

features.name: Elemental Focus (Su)
features.summary: At 1st level, the elemental master must select one element: air, earth, fire, or water. The arcanist can prepare one additional spell per day of each level she can cast, but it must have the elemental descriptor of her chosen element. In addition, any spell she prepares from the opposite elemental school (air opposes earth, fire opposes water) takes up two of her prepared spell slots. This ability replaces the arcanist exploit gained at 1st level.

features.name: Elemental Attack (Su)
features.summary: At 3rd level, the elemental master gains an arcanist exploit tied to her element. Air grants lightning lance, earth grants acid jet, fire grants flame arc, and water grants ice missile. Each attack spends 1 arcane reservoir point. This ability replaces the arcanist exploit gained at 3rd level.

resourceActions.label: Use Lightning Lance

riders.name: Lightning Lance impaired vision
riders.description: Treat all creatures as having concealment (20% miss chance).

resourceActions.summary: Make a ranged touch attack. On a hit, deal scaling electricity damage; a Fortitude save negates 1 round of impaired vision.

resourceActions.label: Use Acid Jet

riders.name: Acid Jet sickened
riders.description: Sickened by the elemental master's acid jet.

resourceActions.summary: Make a ranged touch attack. On a hit, deal scaling acid damage; a Fortitude save negates being sickened for 1d4 rounds.

resourceActions.label: Use Flame Arc
resourceActions.summary: Deal scaling fire damage to every creature in a line; each creature can attempt a Reflex save for half damage.

resourceActions.label: Use Ice Missile

riders.name: Ice Missile staggered
riders.description: Staggered by the elemental master's ice missile.

resourceActions.summary: Make a ranged touch attack. On a hit, deal scaling cold damage; a Fortitude save negates being staggered for 1 round.

features.name: Powerful Exploit (Su)
features.summary: At 9th level, an elemental master increases the damage done by her elemental attack to 1d8 points of energy damage plus 1d8 points of damage per two arcanist levels she possesses. The type of damage is determined by the elemental attack. In addition, the range for the elemental attack ability increases to 60 feet (in the case of flame arc, a 60-foot line). This ability replaces the arcanist exploit gained at 9th level.

features.name: Greater Elemental Attack (Su)
features.summary: At 11th level, the elemental master gains a greater version of her elemental attack: dancing electricity, lingering acid, burning flame, or icy tomb. Each greater attack spends 2 arcane reservoir points. This ability replaces the arcanist exploit gained at 11th level.

resourceActions.label: Use Dancing Electricity

riders.name: Lightning Lance impaired vision
riders.description: Treat all creatures as having concealment (20% miss chance).

resourceActions.summary: Resolve lightning lance and deal half its rolled electricity damage to every adjacent creature; each adjacent creature makes a Reflex save for half again.

resourceActions.label: Use Lingering Acid

riders.name: Acid Jet sickened
riders.description: Sickened by the elemental master's acid jet.

riders.name: Lingering Acid
riders.description: Take additional acid damage on following rounds: {lingeringDice}. The sequence ends after its 1-die round.

resourceActions.summary: Resolve acid jet; on a failed Fortitude save, also apply the automatically calculated sequence of diminishing acid damage.

resourceActions.label: Use Burning Flame

riders.name: Burning Flame
riders.description: On fire; take 3d6 fire damage at the start of each turn. A full-round Reflex save or at least 1 gallon of water extinguishes the flames.

resourceActions.summary: Resolve flame arc; each creature that fails its Reflex save catches fire and takes 3d6 fire damage per turn until extinguished.

resourceActions.label: Use Icy Tomb

riders.name: Ice Missile staggered
riders.description: Staggered by the elemental master's ice missile.

riders.name: Icy Tomb
riders.description: Entangled (not anchored) and takes 1 Dexterity damage at the start of each turn. Escape with a standard-action Strength check DC {breakDc}; more than 10 fire damage from one attack also ends the effect.

resourceActions.summary: Resolve ice missile; on a failed Fortitude save, encase the target in rime for 1 minute per arcanist level.

features.name: Elemental Movement (Su)
features.summary: At 15th level, the chosen element permanently grants its matching movement mode. This ability replaces the arcanist exploit gained at 15th level.

progressionProfiles.label: Air elemental movement
progressionProfiles.summary: Gain a 90-foot fly speed with average maneuverability.

progressionProfiles.label: Fire elemental movement
progressionProfiles.summary: Increase base land speed by 30 feet.

mechanicalNotes: Element selection, restricted bonus preparation slots, and opposition preparation costs are automated.
All four elemental attacks roll their attack, damage, saving throw, and condition riders while spending the correct reservoir cost.
Powerful Exploit scaling, all four greater exploits, and element-specific movement are applied automatically from the selected element.
